The Indian Air Force has officially released the Airforce Agniveer Result on 16th June 2026 at agnipathvayu.cdac.in. Candidates who have attended the online examination of Phase-I on 30th & 31st March 2026 can check their qualifying status by logging in with their registered Email ID and Password. The Airforce Agniveer Vayu 01/2027 result will be declared after the objection process of the answer key and evaluation of the candidates’ responses is completed. The qualified candidates in the online examination will now be taken to next stages of selection process including Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Tests, Document Verification and Medical Examination.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2027 Out

The Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Result 2026 for Phase-I has been released for candidates who appeared in the online examination conducted in CBT mode. The Air Force Agniveer Phase-I Exam 2026 was completely objective in nature, where Science stream candidates attempted a 1-hour paper covering English, Physics and Mathematics, while Other Than Science stream candidates appeared for a 45-minute test including English, Reasoning, and General Awareness (RAGA). The Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 recruitment also witnessed a massive response with over 36,20,845 applications making the competition highly intense for the Indian Airforce Agniveer.

Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake Result 2027: Overview

The Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Result 2026 has been released for Phase-I examination. Applicants can now check their result status and download the scorecard through the official website. This overview provides key details such as exam date, answer key release and result status.

Particulars Details

Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2026 Download Link

The Indian Air Force has activated Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result Link on the official website. The candidates can check the results from the candidate portal using their registered credentials. The result contains the candidate’s qualification status for the next phase of recruitment.

Direct Link for Indian Airforce Agniveer 01/2027 Result

How to Download Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu Result 2027?

Candidates who have appeared in Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 can easily download their result through the official portal once it is declared. Follow the step-by-step process carefully to get your scorecard without any hassle.

  • Click on the official website of Indian Air Force Agnipath Vayu portal. (agnipathvayu.cdac.in and indianairforce.nic.in)
  • Click on the “Candidate Login” link on the homepage.
  • Enter your Email Id, Password and Captcha Code (as displayed in image).
  • Click the “Submit” button.
  • The Agniveer Vayu Result 2026 will be shown on the screen.
  • Take a printout of the result and scorecard for the upcoming selection stages.

Details Mentioned on Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2026

Candidates who have appeared for the Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result should carefully check all the details mentioned on their scorecard after downloading it from the official portal.

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Registration Number
  • Roll Number
  • Date of Birth
  • Category
  • Marks Obtained
  • Qualification Status
  • Instructions for Phase-II Examination

IAF Vayu Intake 01/2027 Merit List

The Indian Air Force Agniveer Vayu 2027 Merit List will be prepared based on candidates’ performance in the Phase-I online examination. It contains the roll numbers and the names of the candidates who have secured the requisite qualifying marks and have been shortlisted for Phase-II of the selection process. Final merit list is prepared based on scores in written exam, category wise reservation, total vacancies and overall competition level.

Expected Indian Airforce Agniveer Cut Off Marks 2026

The Indian Air Force Agniveer Cut Off 2026 will be officially released along with the result on the recruitment portal. These marks represent the minimum qualifying score required to move to the next stage of selection. The factors on which the qualifying marks are determined includes competition level, vacancies and exam difficulty.

Category Expected Cut Off (Marks)
General (UR) 45 – 55 Marks
OBC 40 – 50 Marks
SC 35 – 45 Marks
ST 30 – 40 Marks
EWS 42 – 52 Marks

What’s Next After Airforce Agniveer Vayu Result 2026?

After the declaration of the Indian Airforce Agniveer Vayu Intake 01/2027 Result, shortlisted candidates move forward to Phase-II of the selection process. This stage is crucial as it evaluates physical fitness, adaptability and medical standards required for service in the Indian Air Force.

  • Physical Fitness Test (PFT): The next stage is qualifying the 1.6 km run in 6 minutes 30 seconds along with 10 sit ups, 10 push ups and 20 squats in the prescribed time limits.
  • Adaptability Test: The qualified candidates of the PFT appear for an objective test to check their adaptability to different terrains, weather conditions and operational environments of Indian Air Force.
  • Medical Examination Candidates who qualify in the above tests are subjected to a detailed medical check-up including vision, hearing and overall physical fitness assessment as per IAF medical standards.

FAQs on Indian Airforce Agniveer Result 2026

Q1. What is the release date of the Airforce Agniveer Vayu Result 2026?

The IAF result 2027 has been released on 16th June 2026 for Phase-I candidates at agnipathvayu.cdac.in.

Q2. How to check Agniveer Vayu Intake Result 2027?

Candidates can check their result by visiting the official website and click on Candidate Login and enter their registered Email ID, Password and Captcha code.

Q3. What is the next process after the Airforce Agniveer Result 2026?

Qualified candidates of written exam will be called for Phase-II i.e. Physical Fitness Test (PFT), Adaptability Tests and Medical Examination.

Q4. What details are needed to download Agniveer Vayu scorecard?

Candidates can download their scorecard by using their registered Email ID and Password used during application process.

Q5. Is the Agniveer merit list of Indian Airforce is for selection?

Yes, merit list is very important as only those candidates will be shortlisted for Phase-II of the selection process who will have their names in the merit list.
